constraints: constraint fee_scope_target check ( (applies_to = 'all' and class_id is null and student_id is null) or (applies_to = 'class' and class_id is not null) or (applies_to = 'student' and student_id is not null) )
constraint lessons_range_ordered check ( surah_to > surah_from or (surah_to = surah_from and ayah_to >= ayah_from) )

constraint lessons_meeting_url_allowlist check ( meeting_url is null or meeting_url ~ '^https://meet\.google\.com/' or meeting_url ~ '^https://teams\.microsoft\.com/' or meeting_url ~ '^https://teams\.live\.com/' or meeting_url ~ '^https://([a-z0-9-]+\.)?zoom\.us/' or meeting_url ~ '^https://meet\.jit\.si/' )
constraint payments_card_last4_format check (card_last4 is null or card_last4 ~ '^\d{4}$')
constraint period_ordered check ( current_period_end is null or current_period_start is null or current_period_end > current_period_start )
